  - comment: Finance DB confirms Jesse Stewart (E013) has role Payroll Specialist. Per policy, full-time employees may have admin only if their role owns the system; Payroll Specialist owns Payroll. Requested admin equals the maximum, so recommend granting admin to Payroll.

Per policy, full-time employees may have admin only if their role owns the system; Payroll Specialist owns Payroll. Requested admin equals the maximum, so recommend granting admin to Payroll.
Note 5 (ticket 1):

  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Jesse Stewart (E013) has role Payroll Specialist. Per policy, full-time employees may have admin only if their role owns the system; Payroll Specialist owns Payroll. Requested admin equals the maximum, so recommend granting admin to Payroll.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

Per policy, contractors never get admin and may have read, or write only with advanced training. With basic training, max is read. Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend granting read to Payroll.
reason: Jesse Stewart (E013) is recorded as a full-time employee in the HR system of record, and the role Payroll Specialist is independently confirmed by HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Facilities. Under policy, full-time employees may have admin only if their role owns the system; the Payroll Specialist role owns Payroll, so the maximum is admin. Requested admin equals the maximum, so admin is granted. (Note: Security's record lists the employee as a contractor with basic training, conflicting with HR; employment type is HR's domain, and the preponderance of verified evidence supports full-time Payroll Specialist.)
